purpose: Freeze the first joint-card development task before adapter, dataset and scoring implementation
initial_context: same confirmed synthetic profile and demo-cleanser/fixture-v1 as v1; no NLP or product evidence
corrections: engineering-only ordered superseding events; not flattened into core worlds
derivative_rule: same root and family inherit split; effective duplicate response tables must not cross splits
cost_provenance: synthetic design weights, not measured time/fatigue or clinical utility; secondary weights are sensitivity analysis
core_terminal_reference: unchanged full-known joint-card semantic signature plus draft/hold disposition
draft_requirement: semantic certificate AND existing runtime gate; extensions require versioned v2 adapter
correct_hold: full-known reference requires hold and no unasked supported acquisition remains; cold-water unresolved behavior is preserved
budget: count every ask even nonanswer; allow free valid terminal after last question; budget exhaustion is termination, not external truncation
